WITH -- 1. 总成层去重（按总成物料 + 日期天） assembly_base AS ( SELECT material_code, MAX(material_desc) AS material_desc, TRUNC(schedule_time) AS schedule_date, MAX(quantity) AS quantity, MAX(completed_quantity) AS completed_quantity, MAX(stock) AS stock FROM aps_matching_result m
GROUP BY material_code, TRUNC(schedule_time) ), -- 2. 采购件层统计缺口子件数（按总成 + 日期天） shortage_count AS ( SELECT material_code, TRUNC(schedule_time) AS schedule_date, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN open_order_quantity > 0 THEN purchase_material END) AS shortageCount FROM aps_matching_result m
GROUP BY material_code, TRUNC(schedule_time) ) -- 3. 按维度聚合（日/周/月） SELECT a.material_code AS materialCode, MAX(a.material_desc) AS materialDesc,
TO_CHAR(a.schedule_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
TO_CHAR(a.schedule_date, 'YYYY-"W"IW')
TO_CHAR(a.schedule_date, 'YYYY-MM')
TO_CHAR(a.schedule_date, 'YYYY-"W"IW')
AS timeDimension, SUM(a.quantity) AS planQty, SUM(a.completed_quantity) AS completedQty, MAX(a.stock) AS stockQty, NVL(MAX(s.shortageCount), 0) AS shortageCount -- Oracle 10g 兼容空值转0 FROM assembly_base a LEFT JOIN shortage_count s ON a.material_code = s.material_code AND a.schedule_date = s.schedule_date GROUP BY a.material_code,
TO_CHAR(a.schedule_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
TO_CHAR(a.schedule_date, 'YYYY-"W"IW')
TO_CHAR(a.schedule_date, 'YYYY-MM')
TO_CHAR(a.schedule_date, 'YYYY-"W"IW')
ORDER BY timeDimension DESC, materialCode

WITH assembly_base AS ( SELECT material_code, MAX(material_desc) AS material_desc, TRUNC(schedule_time) AS schedule_date, MAX(quantity) AS quantity, MAX(completed_quantity) AS completed_quantity, MAX(stock) AS stock FROM aps_matching_result m
GROUP BY material_code, TRUNC(schedule_time) ) SELECT a.material_code AS materialCode, MAX(a.material_desc) AS materialDesc,
TO_CHAR(a.schedule_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') TO_CHAR(a.schedule_date, 'YYYY-"W"IW') TO_CHAR(a.schedule_date, 'YYYY-MM') TO_CHAR(a.schedule_date, 'YYYY-"W"IW') AS timeDimension, SUM(a.quantity) AS planQty, SUM(a.completed_quantity) AS completedQty, MAX(a.stock) AS stockQty FROM assembly_base a GROUP BY a.material_code,
TO_CHAR(a.schedule_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') TO_CHAR(a.schedule_date, 'YYYY-"W"IW') TO_CHAR(a.schedule_date, 'YYYY-MM') TO_CHAR(a.schedule_date, 'YYYY-"W"IW')
ORDER BY timeDimension DESC, materialCode

SELECT purchase_material, purchase_material_desc, SUM(open_order_quantity) AS shortageQty, TO_CHAR(required_delivery_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS expectedDate, supplier_name, schedule_time FROM aps_matching_result WHERE deleted = 0 AND material_code = #{materialCode} AND open_order_quantity > 0
AND schedule_time >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND schedule_time < TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1
GROUP BY purchase_material,purchase_material_desc,required_delivery_date,supplier_name,schedule_time ORDER BY purchase_material
